messages.subject: Satorra Bentler x Lavaan
parts:
I was reading in MAROCO's book (2010) that the X2 test is sensitive to violation of assumptions about the normal distribution of variables and to correct this problem the "Satorra-Bentler correction" was created.
 Is this correction implemented in the lavaan?

messages.author: 7bbcb4cbe7d0bc68
messages.subject: Re: Satorra Bentler x Lavaan
parts:
Hi Elias

You can choose the Satorra-Bentler correction of the chi-square test (or other correction procedures) by using the option test="Satorra.Bentler". As an example

model1.fit <- cfa(model1, data=mydata, test="Satorra.Bentler")

This should be analogous when you're using the sem() or lavaan() functions. Type ?lavOptions in R and look under "test".

I've only been using lavaan for a while, so there may be more details to this which are unknown to me.

Best, Chris
